headline: Treasury yields fall as oil prices slide
detail: Falling Treasury yields are generally bullish for growth and tech stocks, as they reduce borrowing costs and increase the present value of future earnings. Lower oil prices can also ease inflation concerns, further supporting market sentiment.
rec: No direct trade, but this macro trend is favorable for your highly concentrated tech portfolio.
